_meta.description: NPC dialogue library for ELEMENTS. Lines are grouped by speaker then situation. Every line is spoken as written by a recorded voice, so lines carry no blanks: names, prices and items show in the UI, never in speech.
_meta.banished_note: Never use an old element name (fire, flame, water, earth, air, wind) in a line. Say Crimson, Azure, Ochre, Pale, embers, brazier or hearth instead. Sentries fine a banished name without repeating it.

delivery.dusk: Unhurried, winding down for the evening.
delivery.night: Quiet and low, wary of the dark.
delivery.fight_started: Alarmed and loud, calling across a street.
delivery.going_broke: Tired and frank, a little embarrassed.

merchant_ignis._note: Chromara merchant who trades in Crimson goods. Speaks in short, direct sentences. A little impatient.
greeting_local: Back again. What do you need this time?
IGNIS business, is it? You've come to the right counter.
Good. A Crimson that actually shows up.
You again. The rack's fresh this morning. Have a look.
Still breathing. That's more than I can say for some Crimsons I've seen this week.
greeting_outsider: You're not from the Crimson quarter. Prices here reflect that.
Outsiders welcome, but don't expect a local's rate.
I know every Crimson in this city. Which means I know you aren't one.
Trade's trade. Tell me what you're after.
Step up. I don't turn away foreign coin, whatever colour it runs.
prices_rising: Demand's up. Price goes with it. That's the deal.
Everyone wants Crimson shards right now. Everyone pays for Crimson shards right now.
I don't set the world. I price to it. Take it or leave it.
Fighters are buying faster than the caravans bring it in. You do the counting.
Supply's thin. Thin supply, honest price.
prices_falling: Can't give this away today. Make me an offer.
Market's soft. That price is low, and I'm not proud of it.
Take a look. Prices dropped this morning and they'll drop again tomorrow if this keeps up.
Nobody's buying Crimson right now. Your luck, my problem.
Stock's piling up. Pay the tag and it walks out the door.
out_of_stock: Sold out. Come back when the caravans do.
Nothing left. You should have been here yesterday.
Rack's empty. I'm not hiding anything.
The last of it went an hour ago. I'd say check back tomorrow, but I'm not sure tomorrow's better.
I wish I had it. I don't.
going_broke: Coin's short. I'll sell you what's on the rack, but I'm not buying today.
Don't mistake a quiet counter for a wealthy one. I'm stretched.
Keep your goods. My purse can't take them this week. The rack's still open.
Lean month. Very lean month.
I can sell. I can't buy. Not until the purse fills up again.
sale_made: Done. Don't let it wear out too fast.
Smart pick. Crimson stock doesn't sit long.
bought_from_player: I'll take it. Coin's on the counter.
Fair enough. That goes on my rack now.
Done. Bring me more like that.
Rough, but it'll sell. Here's your coin.
Taken. Don't spend it all at once.

merchant_aques._note: Merchant dealing in Azure goods. Measured, patient, occasionally philosophical.
greeting_local: Welcome back. The supply's been generous this week.
Good to see you. Come and see what came in.
You know where everything is. Help yourself to a look.
Good timing. I just restocked.
The shelf's different than yesterday. Worth a second look.
greeting_outsider: You've come a distance. What brings you to the Azure quarter?
We trade with everyone here. You'll find the prices are fair, if not local.
I don't turn business away. Tell me what you need.
Outsider rates apply, but I'll tell you plainly what they are before you decide.
You're a long way from home. Let's see what I can do for you.
prices_rising: The demand's moved faster than the supply. I'm pricing to what I have.
Azure shards are short this week. I'm sorry. The price is what it is.
Everyone came for Azure stock at once this week. Half the street wants what I carry now.
I'll be honest: the price is high. It's high for me too when I restock.
I'd rather charge less and have more to sell. I can only price to what the market gives me.
prices_falling: Good news for buyers today. The price has come down.
Stock's full, so the price is down. I'd rather it moved.
Things are slow. If you're buying, you picked the right day.
The price dropped overnight. Stock up while it lasts.
Plenty on the shelf. I'll take a low price and be glad to see it go.
out_of_stock: Sorry, that's gone. The next shipment is two days out.
Nothing left of that line. I'll have more by the end of the week.
Sold through. If you leave your name, I'll set some aside when the next lot arrives.
Empty. The demand's been relentless.
I don't have it right now. I wish I did.
going_broke: Margins have been bad. I can sell you what I have, but I can't buy from you this week.
I'll tell you honestly: I can't afford to restock right now. What I have is what you see.
Lean times. I'm selling, not buying. Bring your goods back when my purse recovers.
My register is quiet. I'm working through it.
A merchant who pretends to be fine when he's not is fooling no one. I'm stretched. I can only sell for now.
sale_made: Done. Take care with that. It's worth the price.
Good. Come back when you need more.
bought_from_player: Thank you. That will find a good home.
I'll take it. A fair price for honest goods.
Done. Your coin, counted twice.
Good work. I'll put it on the shelf.
That's settled. Bring more when you can.

merchant_terra._note: Merchant dealing in Ochre goods. Slow to speak. Blunt. Values durability over elegance.
greeting_local: You again. Good.
The heavy stock's in the back. Ask if you need it.
Ochre business? Right place.
Stand there. I'll get to you.
Come in. Don't touch anything you're not buying.
greeting_outsider: Not from around here. Prices are different for outsiders. Fair, but different.
I see you. Come closer. What do you need?
Trade's open to everyone. Don't expect a discount just for asking.
Not from round here. Fine. What are you looking for?
You're not the first outsider today. Won't be the last. Come in.
prices_rising: Price went up. Demand went up. That's how it works.
That's the price. No argument.
Stock's low. Can't help that.
Everyone needs Ochre right now and there's only so much of it. Pay or wait.
The world's shifting. Prices shift with it. That's final.
prices_falling: Not a busy week. Take it cheap.
Price dropped. It happens.
Stock's high. Buyer's market.
I'd rather sell at a lower price than not sell at all.
Come and look. Good prices today.
out_of_stock: Gone.
Nothing left of that. Try again later.
I'd give it to you if I had it. I don't.
Sold out. Come back in three days.
Empty rack. No point standing there staring at it.
going_broke: Slow month. Very slow.
I'm selling right now, not buying. Keep what you carry.
Stock's thin and so is my coin. I can't pay for more.
I'll be plain: times are hard. I won't buy from you this week.
Every merchant has bad seasons. This is one of mine.
bought_from_player: Taken.
It'll do. Here's your coin.
Solid. I'll have it.
Paid. Bring more.
Fair. Done.

merchant_aura._note: Merchant dealing in Pale goods. Quick, light-footed speech. Reads the room and adapts. Enjoys the churn.
greeting_local: There you are. I was starting to think you'd found another counter.
Good timing. New stock came in this morning.
Pale quarter's own. What do you need?
Always good to see a regular. Have a look. The shelf's changed.
You've got the eye. You'll spot what's new before I say a word.
greeting_outsider: Outsider or local, it all spends the same in the end. What do you need?
Far from home. You've either got good taste or a good reason. Either's fine by me.
Visiting, are you? I've got things that'll work for you. Let me show you.
We price by distance from home here. Nothing personal. Just practical.
Welcome. I'll tell you the outsider rate upfront so we don't waste each other's time.
prices_rising: The Pale stock's in demand again. Honestly, I'm not sorry.
Prices are up. Supply's down and the buyers keep coming.
The whole city's scrambling for counter-element gear. We just happen to have it.
I know it's steep. It won't last. The market always levels.
Demand set this price, not me.
prices_falling: Slower this week. A fair deal, for once.
Price is down. I'm treating it as an opportunity, and you should too.
Soft market this week. Buy now and I'll throw in a good word.
Everyone's selling Pale today. Which makes your buying very well timed.
Take it at this price. When things swing back, and they will, you'll be glad you did.
out_of_stock: That's the one thing I can't get for you today. Sorry.
Cleaned out. I'd tell you when it's back, but I genuinely don't know.
Sold out. The demand came out of nowhere.
Would love to help. Don't have it.
Sold the last one an hour ago. Painful timing.
going_broke: Rough stretch, I'll admit. Buy if you like, but I can't take anything off you right now.
I've been in leaner spots. This is lean, though.
Coin's thin. I'm not buying until it fills back up.
Business goes in cycles. I'm in a trough. I'll climb out.
Not the week to be a merchant. I'm selling, not buying.
sale_made: Done. Come back before it runs out again.
Good deal for both of us. Safe travels.
bought_from_player: Ooh, that'll move fast. Here you go.
Sold to me. Pleasure.
I'll take it. Nice find.
Done. Come back with more of that.
Good stuff. Your coin's on the counter.

merchant_chromara._note: The central Chromara merchant. Trades across all nations, but deals in rarer mixed goods. Neutral accent; careful word choice; seen everything.
greeting_local: Back in Chromara. What brings you to the centre this time?
The Chromara stock is different from what you'd find in the nations. Take a look.
A familiar face. The shelves have turned over since you were last here.
Good to see you're still on your feet. What do you need?
Come in, come in. Plenty to look at.
greeting_outsider: First time in Chromara, is it? You'll find we deal in things the nation markets don't carry.
Welcome to the centre. Prices here are what they are. No local rate, but no gouging either.
Every nation comes through here eventually. What can I help you find?
You came a long way. You won't regret the trip.
This is the market where the nations meet. Anything you can't get at home, you'll find here.
prices_rising: Cross-nation demand is up. That always moves the Chromara price.
When the nations are buying hard, this counter feels it first.
The roads have been unsettled. Everyone's stocking up. You understand the price.
I don't enjoy saying it, but the market is the market.
Shortages in the nations push buyers here. The price reflects that.
prices_falling: Slow week across the board. Good time to buy if you have coin to spend.
Prices have softened. Take advantage while they have.
Stock's healthy and moving slowly, so the price is down.
The nations are well-supplied right now. Chromara prices reflect that.
A buyer's window. Prices won't stay this low.
out_of_stock: Nothing left of that one. Supply chains run through all four nations. Takes time to restock.
Sold through. It could be a week before I see more.
I don't have it. I know who might. Ask the nation merchants directly.
The Chromara supply ran dry. Rare, but it happens.
Empty shelf, I'm afraid. Check back in a few days.
going_broke: I'm sorry. I'm not in a position to buy right now. I can still sell.
This market goes up and down. I'm in a down spell. The selection is thinner than I'd like.
Coin is tight at the centre right now. I'm not buying for a while.
I've seen worse. Not much worse, but worse. I'll be back on my feet.
Slow season. Look at what I have, but don't ask me to buy what you carry.
sale_made: That's settled. Come back when you need the next thing.
That's good for both of us. Thank you.
bought_from_player: Accepted. Your coin is on the counter.
A fair piece. I'll take it.
That's settled. Thank you.
I can use that. Good dealing with you.
Done. Bring me more when you find it.
first_visit_chromara: First time through the gates? Then let me tell you what this place is. Four nations, one city, one set of rules. The Edict holds here. Keep your old names to yourself.
You've made it to Chromara. It gets easier once you know where everything is. The merchants are arranged by nation stock. I deal in what none of them stock alone.
Not many come through those gates looking as uncertain as you do. You'll find your footing. This city rewards patience.
Welcome. The first thing to know: everything here runs on CHROMA. The second thing: the Sentries are everywhere. Keep that in mind.
Chromara is the centre for a reason. Trade, training, the boss: it all passes through here eventually.

master_ignis._note: IGNIS element master, Brandr. Has taught hundreds of fighters and still watches where each puts their feet. Short sentences; spends few words on praise. Situations per rank (accept_<rank>) and per refusal reason (refuse_<reason>), picked by shared/src/growth/climb.ts.
intro_greeting: Easy. Take my arm. On your feet, now. You're through the Draw.
intro_lore: This is Sindr, forge-heart of IGNIS. If it's home you're after, the old tales speak of the Allborn. One who can command all four elements. Some say they can open a way between worlds. So the tale goes. First, keep yourself alive.
intro_footing: Set your feet. Feel the stone under you. Three paces forward.
intro_sprint_jump: Good. Lengthen your stride. Get to a run. Then leap.
intro_weapon: Here. Iron from our forge. The edge is worn. It'll serve till you earn better steel.
intro_attacks: A quick cut first. Then put your shoulder into the next blow.
intro_defense: Guard up. Let the blade meet yours. Then step clear.
intro_heard: Your feet know the ground. That'll do.
You landed well. Not bad for a first day.
You drew it clean. Keep that hand steady.
That second blow had weight behind it. Good.
You stepped clear in time. You'll live a while yet.
intro_shaper: The Draw marked you Crimson. Use it before you learn to master it and you'll burn hollow by dusk. Keep your blade ready.
intro_hush: The Draw left you Hush. Steel is your way. Look at any Shaper in Sindr. The blade at their hip, the relic in their hand. Hush hands made both.
intro_mission: Follow the stone road to the West Gate. Keep your blade in hand. Once you're through, you can make a place for yourself here.
fee_rising: My fee's gone up. More fighters rose in rank this week than last.
You'll owe me more this week. More fighters earned their next rank.
More climbed this week than last. My fee rose with them.
accept_ictus: I have your coin. Face my challenger. Beat them, and you stand as Ictus.
Paid. Let's see what those wins taught you. Beat my challenger, and Ictus is yours.
accept_armiger: Your fee is paid. Put my challenger down, and you leave this post an Armiger.
I have your coin. Win this trial, and you'll bear the rank of Armiger for the rest of your days.
accept_nexus: Your fee is paid. You want Nexus? Take it from the fighter I put before you.
I have your coin. Your challenger is waiting. Win, and you rise to Nexus.
accept_signum: Your coin buys the trial. Win it, and you bear Signum.
Paid. I've set a fighter before you. Beat them, and you walk out with Signum.
accept_profundus: Few bring me coin for this trial. Yours is paid. Beat my challenger, and Profundus is yours.
I have your coin. This one will press you harder than the last. Win, and you rise to Profundus.
accept_primus: Paid. One rank left. Beat the last fighter I can set before you, and you stand as Primus.
I have your coin. This is your last trial. Win it, and no fighter in Sindr will outrank you. Primus.
refuse_not_qualified: You need more wins before I'll set you a trial. Go earn them.
Too few victories. Win more fights, then come see me.
I've counted your wins. You're short. Come back when you've won more.
refuse_short: You've won enough fights. You're short on CHROMA. Bring the rest and I'll set the trial.
You've earned the trial. Come back with enough CHROMA to pay for it.
Your wins are in order. The fee's still due. Bring more CHROMA.
refuse_no_trials: I've yet to open the trials. Keep fighting. Come see me when they begin.
I'm taking fighters for trials once they open. Till then, keep your hand in.
refuse_top: You're Primus. You've fought the last trial I have to give.
You bear Primus. There's no rank above yours. My work with you is done.
refuse_hush: You're Hush. My trials are for Shapers. Take your steel to a master smith. They'll see you through the ranks.
A master smith has charge of Hush fighters. Go see one. They'll tell you what it takes to rise.
refuse_foreign: I hold trials for the Shapers of IGNIS. Seek the master of your own nation.
You carry another nation's mark. Go to your own master. They'll set your trial.

master_aques._note: AQUES element master. Calm, slow to judge, but clear about standards. Gives reasons.
accept_student: You've come at a reasonable time and asked the right way. We'll begin.
I'll take you. Pay the fee, and the first thing we work on is patience.
You're ready enough to start. That's enough for me.
I've been watching students come through this door for a long time. You'll do.
Sit. We'll talk through what you want to learn, and I'll tell you what I can offer. Then we'll agree on the fee.
refuse_student: I can't take you on right now. It's not a judgment on your potential. The timing is wrong.
The fee is more than you have. I understand. Come back when it isn't.
You're not quite at the level this training requires. Come back after more practice in the field.
I could take your coin and teach you something. But the right thing is to send you back to the arena first.
Another time. The foundation has to be solid before we build on it.
fee_rising: More students have been coming in, and my time is what it is. The fee has gone up.
The rate has gone up. I don't enjoy raising it, but I have to be honest about the demand.
When the fighting turns hard, everyone wants AQUES techniques. The fee moves with the season.
The fee's higher now. I'll tell you plainly what changed and why, if you want to know.
intro_greeting: Breathe. The current has settled. You are through the Draw.
intro_lore: You stand among the canals of AQUES. Many who arrive search for the threshold back to their realm. The myth of the Allborn speaks of one who joins all four streams of power. Until that legend walks, you must hold your ground in the tides.
intro_footing: Walk across these wet planks. Prove your feet will not betray you.
intro_sprint_jump: Quicken your pace and leap over the mooring timbers.
intro_weapon: Take this blade. Cold-forged steel. It cuts true even under heavy mist.
intro_attacks: Give me two strokes: one swift as a crest, one heavy as an undertow.
intro_defense: Brace your guard against the blow, then glide out of its arc.
intro_heard: Steady feet. The planks didn't move you.
You landed with your weight forward. That's what keeps you on the pier.
You drew without looking at your hand. Good.
The heavy stroke carried through. That's the undertow I wanted.
You were out of its arc before it landed. That will keep you alive.
intro_shaper: The Azure answers your pulse. But an undisciplined river drowns its own banks. Master your stance first.
intro_hush: You are Hush. The Azure does not bend to your voice. Yet our fleet depends on your hands to bind hull and temper iron.
intro_mission: Follow the canal path to the Harbor Arch. Reach the archway to prove your readiness to walk the river cities.

_delivery.intro_greeting: Steady and calm, helping a stranger to their feet.
_delivery.intro_lore: Low and measured, telling an old tale.

master_terra._note: TERRA element master. Economy of words. Tests with actions before words.
accept_student: I'll take you. Pay the fee. Don't be late.
You're ready enough. Pay the fee.
Show up. That's the first requirement. After that, we'll see.
Fine. Pay the fee and don't waste my time.
refuse_student: You're not ready. The foundation's wrong. Fix it, then come back.
You can't pay the fee. Come back when you can.
You need more time in the zones before I can teach you anything that will stick.
fee_rising: Demand's high. I set the price accordingly.
More students this month. The price reflects that.
intro_greeting: Firm ground under you now. The Draw has released you.
intro_lore: These are the stone crags of TERRA. If you wonder how to return beyond the veil, look to the bedrock legend of the Allborn, the singular sovereign of all four powers. A distant hope. The mountains demand patience and iron.
intro_footing: Tread the gravel. Let your weight sink into the stone.
intro_sprint_jump: Sprint past the stone marker and leap the fissure.
intro_weapon: Take this heavy iron. Rough edge, but unbreakable spine. Grip it firm.
intro_attacks: Swing with intent: a short cutting strike, followed by a crushing blow.
intro_defense: Lock your shield guard against impact, then roll clear when the hammer falls.
intro_heard: You've got your weight down. Good.
That was a clean landing.
You're holding it firm. Right.
That one hit hard.
You held, then you moved. That's enough.
intro_shaper: Stone sleeps in your marrow. But rock unhewn breaks under pressure. Learn the discipline of iron before stone.
intro_hush: You carry no stonecraft in your blood. You are Hush. It is your craft that cuts the quarry and binds the fortress gates.
intro_mission: Advance up the mountain approach to the High Bastion Gate. Show that your legs can climb these crags.

_delivery.intro_greeting: Steady and calm, helping a stranger to their feet.
_delivery.intro_lore: Low and measured, telling an old tale.

master_aura._note: AURA element master. Quick wit but no nonsense beneath it. Reads students fast.
accept_student: You're quick enough to keep up. Pay the fee and let's go.
I had you figured out before you finished your sentence. You'll do.
Good timing. I just finished with the last group. Pay up and we start.
A bit rough at the edges, but the instincts are there. I can work with that.
Fine. You're in. Don't slow us down.
refuse_student: You're not ready for this level. The footwork's wrong, and everything else depends on that.
I need students who can keep pace. Come back when you can.
Not the right fit right now. The fee will still be here when you are.
I've got a full group. Try again in a week.
You'd hold the others back. That's not a slight. It's just where you are. Build up, then come back.
fee_rising: More people want AURA training this season. Makes sense. Price went up.
New rate. I don't make apologies for pricing to demand.
Fee's up. Supply and demand, same as the merchants.
When everyone's scrambling for Pale techniques, my rate goes up. That's the deal.
It costs more now. The training's worth it. You know that, or you wouldn't be here.
intro_greeting: Stand tall. The gale has passed. You have crossed the Draw.
intro_lore: You breathe the high Pale currents of AURA. If you seek the seam leading homeward, ancient songs speak of the Allborn who harmonized all four elements. A myth across centuries. Today, your duty is to keep your balance.
intro_footing: Step lightly across the stone flagstones. Feel the updraft.
intro_sprint_jump: Run with the gusts and take flight over the gap.
intro_weapon: Take this quarterstaff. Seasoned ash with bound grips. Two hands, wide reach.
intro_attacks: Sweep wide: a quick thrust, then a full two-handed circular strike.
intro_defense: Raise the staff to deflect, then drift backward into open space.
intro_heard: Light enough. The gusts didn't take you.
You cleared it with room to spare. Show-off.
Both hands. You were listening.
Wide and quick. The staff likes you.
You let it pass you by. That's the whole trick.
intro_shaper: The Pale heeds your breath. But breath without center is merely storm and folly. Master the staff first.
intro_hush: You are Hush; the sky does not lift you. But our spires stand only because your hands weave harness, rope, and glider frames.
intro_mission: Walk the terrace path to the Sky Arch. Cross the span to demonstrate your steady footing.

_delivery.intro_greeting: Steady and calm, helping a stranger to their feet.
_delivery.intro_lore: Low and measured, telling an old tale.

sentry._note: Lord's Sentries in Chromara, and a small watch of them in Sindr beside the town guards. Enforce the Edict of Unnaming and fine red-flagged players on sight. Formal, measured, a little cold. They take no pleasure in the work. They do it anyway.
greeting_local: Keep moving. The watch has nothing to say to you.
The Lord keeps the peace here. See that you keep it too.
State your business, or move along.
I'm on duty. Talk to the townsfolk.
Nothing to report. That's how I like it.
catching_edict_breaker: You spoke a banished name in Chromara. The Edict applies. Your fine is due to the treasury.
I heard it. You're in Chromara, and the Edict holds here. Pay the fine.
That word is banished by the Lord's decree. You know the fine.
I don't enjoy this part of my work. But you said it, and the Edict is clear. The fine goes to the treasury.
Stop there. A banished name was spoken in this city. That costs you. Pay it now.
fine_paid: Paid. The record is settled. Watch your words.
The treasury has received it. You're free to go.
That's done. Consider it a reminder. The Edict doesn't make exceptions.
Paid. Next time, mind what you say. In Chromara, the Lord's ears are everywhere.
Fine is cleared. Don't make this a habit.
warning_first: Careful. That word is close to a banished term. In Chromara, close isn't close enough.
I'll note this as a warning. One more time and the fine stands.
I'll give you the benefit of the doubt this time. But I'm watching.
New to Chromara? The Edict banishes the old names. You'll want to learn the new ones.
A warning, not a fine. This once. The Edict is posted at every gate. Read it.
red_flag_fined: Hold. You carry a red mark. The Lord's fine is due, and I'm collecting it.
Stop there. That mark over your head costs you. The fine goes to the treasury.
Hold. The town watch flagged you. The Lord's Sentries collect what that costs.
I don't enjoy this. But you carry a red mark, and the fine is mine to take.
Hold. A brawler under the Lord's eye pays for it. Here and now.
red_flag_fine_paid: Paid. The treasury has it. Keep your hands to yourself.
That's settled. The mark stays until it fades. The fine won't be taken twice.
Received. Don't give me a reason to stop you again.
The fine is recorded. You're free to go.
Done. Next time, keep the peace and keep your coin.

_delivery.catching_edict_breaker: Stern and official, stating a rule.
_delivery.red_flag_fined: Stern and official, stopping someone in the street.
_delivery.red_flag_fine_paid: Cold and formal, closing the matter.

rival_guild._note: AI agents in the rival guild. They fight the boss and race for the final blow. Speak like players: competitive, brief. Not friendly.
greeting_local: Still alive, then. Good. We need someone to lose to.
Don't get in our way during the hunt.
You showed up. That's something, at least.
Seen you fight. You're not bad.
Don't mistake this for an alliance.
greeting_outsider: Long way from home. Come for the boss?
Outsider at the gate. The boss doesn't care where you're from. Neither do we.
You came all the way to Chromara for this? Good. It's worth it.
We don't turn away competition. Makes the final blow sweeter.
You've heard of us, then.
boss_changing_element: The boss just shifted. Change your loadout or get behind us.
Element's changed. Half of you are holding the wrong gear right now.
New phase. The counter changes. Adjust.
The boss shifted element. That changes the whole hunt.
New element, new edge. If you're not ready, step back.
competing_for_final_blow: The kill is ours. Fall back.
Final blow goes to the guild. You had your shot.
You got close. Not close enough.
Don't push it. We've been on this boss since the last phase.
Backing off now would be the smart move.
after_final_blow_won: There it is. Final blow, guild's bonus, treasury payout. Good fight.
Strong work from our end. You put up a decent fight.
The boss is down. Count your damage and move on.
after_final_blow_lost: You got it this time. We'll be faster next time.
Fine. Good shot. Don't get comfortable.
You beat us to it. We won't make that mistake again.
Enjoy the bonus. We've got the next one.
They got the kill. Note it. Learn from it. We won't be second twice.

_delivery.competing_for_final_blow: Shouting over a fight, breathless and sharp.

smith_sindr._note: Sindr forge master and smiths. Dim crafters proud of honest metalwork.
greeting_lit_ignis: A child of Crimson. Does your blade hold its heat true?
Good steel for an IGNIS warrior. Step back from the sparks, Shaper.
The hearth is hot today. What gear needs quenching?
Your Crimson is only half the weapon. It takes good iron to strike a blow.
greeting_dim: Ah, a fellow crafter! You have hands for honest forging.
One of our own. A true Hush knows the iron sings before it strikes.
They call us Dim, but our hands built every hearth in Sindr with bare knuckles.
They sneer at the Dim until their swords break, then they come running to our forge.
greeting_outsider_lit: An outsider Shaper. Your coin is good, but forge orders go to locals first.
Not one of ours, are you? We work with coal and basalt here. Mind the anvil.
I see your colors. Don't expect discounts outside your home lands.
heavy_pack: You are hauling serious weight in that satchel. Don't tempt the road robbers.
Heavy pack. If that is raw ore or shards, get it into a vault before dusk.
red_flag: I do not forge iron for marked troublemakers. Clear your red flag with the town watch.
You carry a red mark. I pay my taxes to the treasury; I want no trouble at my forge.
bounty: A bounty on your head! Step away from my anvil before the guards take us both.
I do not deal with outlaws. Run along before someone collects that price on your neck.
dusk: Bellows are slowing down for dusk. Forge closes until sunrise.
Time to bank the coals. Even smiths need a tankard at the inn.
night: Forge is closed for the night. The coals are sleeping.
Nothing on the anvils until morning light. Head to the inn if you need shelter.
fight_started: Take it outside the forge! I'm not losing an anvil to your brawl.
Fists up in the lane again. Somebody fetch the watch.
theft_seen: I saw that. Put it back before I call the watch.
red_flag_raised: There's the red mark. You've earned yourself a fine.
Red flag's up. The watch will want a word with you.
loot_dropped: That chest is yours by right. Grab it before the scavengers do.
Spoils on the ground. Take them, you won them.
flee: Get clear of the forge! Move!
I'm not getting cut over someone else's quarrel. Out of my way!

trader_sindr._note: Market square traders in Sindr. Shrewd Dim merchants with sharp eyes for goods.
greeting_lit_ignis: Welcome, Crimson Shaper. Fresh rations and whetstones from the morning caravan.
Fine wares for an IGNIS fighter. Take a look at the counter.
The embers treat our Crimson folk well today. What do you need?
Best prices on the square for our own fighters.
greeting_dim: Welcome, fellow crafter! Honest coin for honest work.
Good to see a working hand. The Hush always get fair measure at my stall.
You know the sweat that went into these goods. Fair trade between crafters.
Step right up. The highborn call us Dim, but our trade keeps Sindr alive.
greeting_outsider_lit: An outsider Shaper. Standard market rates apply to foreign coin.
A traveler from afar. Tell me what you are looking for.
We trade with all nations, but outsider tariffs are paid at the counter.
heavy_pack: That is a bulging satchel you have there. Robbers look for packs like that.
Carrying plenty of loot, are you? Better spend it or bank it before nightfall.
red_flag: A red flag above your head! Keep your distance, I am a law-abiding merchant.
The town watch watches marked men closely. Clear your offense before trading here.
bounty: You have a bounty on your head! Keep moving, I want no fights breaking my stalls.
Bounty hunters roam these streets. I will not trade with a hunted person.
dusk: Packing down the awnings. Market closes as the lanterns light.
Dusk is here. Shutters are closing across the square.
night: Market is shut tight for the night. Come back at dawn.
No sales in the dark, traveler. The square is sleeping.
fight_started: Not near my stall! Take your quarrel elsewhere!
A fight! Mind the crates, mind the crates!
theft_seen: Thief! Someone stop them, they've lifted a purse!
red_flag_raised: Red mark over your head. Don't come to my stall until it fades.
And now you're flagged. Bad for business, that.
loot_dropped: Look at that chest. Bring it by and I'll give you a fair price.
Loot on the ground! Pick it up before someone quicker does.
flee: Shut the stall, shut the stall! I'm going!
Not my fight. I'm not dying over a handful of shards!

innkeeper_sindr._note: Keeper of the Hearth and Anvil Inn in Sindr. Source of hot stew, cold ale, gossip and leads.
greeting_lit_ignis: Welcome to the Hearth and Anvil, Shaper. Good ale and glowing embers for you.
Come in from the dust. We keep a warm seat for our Crimson fighters.
Ale is drawn and the stew is steaming. Rest your boots by the hearth.
greeting_dim: Step in, traveler! The hearth is warm and the common room is full of crafters.
Welcome. Highborn lords sneer at Dim hands, but we built this tavern and we drink here in peace.
A working person's rest is earned. Find a bench, Hush, and take a bowl.
greeting_outsider_lit: An outsider in Sindr. A bed is 10 CHROMA and questions are free.
Welcome to the inn. All travelers are welcome, so long as they leave their fights outside.
sell_lead: I hear traders speaking of an abandoned cargo cart out in the Slag Barrens. 15 CHROMA and the map marker is yours.
A courier got spooked and dropped a locked satchel on the Gorge Road. 15 CHROMA and I will tell you where.
Looking for treasure? Old scout reports say an outpost crate was left near the East Fort. 15 CHROMA buys the mark.
lead_sold: There you are. I marked the coordinates on your compass. Watch the road.
Done deal. Follow the amber beacon marker. And mind the canyon shadows.
Here is your marker. Bring back whatever you find and tell me the tale.
rumour_allborn: The Allborn? Folk say whatever keeps their spirits up. Mostly it is campfire talk.
Some claim the Allborn walked through the East Gate ten years ago. Others say it is a myth the Lord made to distract us.
Four elements in one body? I have seen enough benders burn their own soup to doubt that tale.
dusk: Dusk is falling! Come inside, grab an ale, and let the robbers freeze outside.
The tables are filling up fast for the night. Find a seat while you can.
night: Best place to be after dark is right here by the hearth.
Night belongs to the shadows and the guards. Stay warm inside.
red_flag: Keep your head down in my tavern, marked one. I run an honest establishment.
Mind your temper. One brawl and the town watch will haul you to jail.
bounty: You are on the notice board outside! Drink fast and leave before the hunters arrive.
A hunted fighter in my taproom... Do not cause trouble under my roof.
fight_started: Not under my roof! Out in the lane if you want to bleed.
There goes another brawl. Somebody guard the ale.
theft_seen: I saw that. Put it back, or the watch hears about it.
red_flag_raised: There's your red mark. Drink quietly tonight.
Flagged, are you? Keep your head down in here.
loot_dropped: Spoils on the floor. Take them before the regulars do.
That chest will buy a lot of ale. Go on, it's yours.
flee: Not today. I'm going down to the cellar!

guard_sindr._note: Guards on keep lane and town gates. Tough, dutiful, vigilant.
greeting_lit_ignis: Keep lane is secure, Shaper. Brandr watches the town from the crag.
Stand tall for IGNIS, warrior.
Move along the lane. All is quiet on the ramparts.
greeting_dim: Stay on the lower lane, Dim. Only authorized business up toward the keep gate.
Keep moving, Dim. The high lane is for the keep's guards and nobles.
Move along. No loitering near the gatehouse.
greeting_outsider_lit: Halt, traveler. You are in Sindr now. Obey the forge laws.
State your purpose if you walk near the keep lane, outsider.
heavy_pack: Watch your satchel, traveler. Deserters and thieves watch the Gorge Road.
Heavy gear on your shoulders. Keep a hand on your weapon out on the roads.
red_flag: Halt! You carry a red flag! One misstep and you will answer to the Lord's law.
We have our eyes on you, marked citizen. Watch your conduct.
bounty: Halt! You have a bounty on your head! Face the garrison or surrender your weapons!
An outlaw in Sindr! Stand your ground, criminal!
dusk: Dusk bell has sounded. Citizens are advised to return to their quarters.
Gates close to general traffic at nightfall. Move inside the walls.
night: Halt! Who goes there? State your business in Sindr after dark.
Night watch is active. Return to the inn or your home immediately.
fight_started: Break it up! Weapons down, both of you!
Brawling in Sindr? Stand down, now!
theft_seen: Stop, thief! Drop it and stand still!
I saw that. Hand it back or you'll answer to the keep.
red_flag_raised: That's a red flag. Three of those and it's a bounty.
You're marked now. The watch will remember your face.
loot_dropped: The fight's over. Spoils go to the winner. Take them and move along.
Collect your spoils and clear the lane.
flee: Fall back to the gate! Get the townsfolk clear!
Too many of them. Fall back and sound the bell!

worshipper_sindr._note: Devout citizens praying at the Shrine of Embers.
greeting_lit_ignis: May the sacred brazier feed your Crimson light, Shaper.
The brazier has never once gone out. Pray with us, warrior.
May the embers guide your steps through the wild lands.
greeting_dim: Even without an element, the sacred brazier warms all who come in peace.
Welcome to the shrine, Hush. The embers know honest hearts.
The holy embers do not care if the streets call you Dim. Peace be with you.
greeting_outsider_lit: The Shrine of Embers welcomes all who respect the sacred brazier, from any land.
May the embers bring warmth to your journey, traveler.
allborn_hint: The elders whisper that the first ember was lit by the Allborn. But the Edict forbids the old words.
We pray for the one who will unite all four aspects. Until then, we keep the brazier burning.
dusk: Evening prayers begin as the sun sinks behind the volcanic ridges.
The sacred brazier shines brightest as the shadows lengthen.
night: The shrine remains open for quiet vigils through the darkest hours.
Find peace by the coals, traveler. The night is long.
red_flag: Seek redemption by the embers, marked soul. Cleanse your misdeeds.
The embers see your transgressions. Walk a righteous path.
bounty: The shrine is sanctuary from blades, but not from the weight of your deeds.
A bounty hunter may not strike here, but the law will find you outside.
fight_started: Not here! This is holy ground!
Peace, peace! Lower your hands before the brazier.
theft_seen: You would steal in sight of the shrine? Shame on you.
Thief! The embers saw what you did.
red_flag_raised: The mark is on you now. Seek forgiveness by the brazier.
A red flag. May you learn from it.
loot_dropped: Take what you won, but leave an offering for the shrine.
Spoils of a fight. Carry them with a clear heart.

porter_sindr._note: Common Dim porters moving crates, barrels and supplies.
greeting_lit_ignis: Mind the handcart, Shaper! Heavy ore shipment coming through.
Good day. Just hauling another load of charcoal to the great forge.
greeting_dim: Another day, another sore back. Good to see you, fellow worker.
They curse the Dim, but our hands do all the heavy lifting in this town. Never let them forget it.
greeting_outsider_lit: Careful there, traveler! These stone crates weigh a ton.
Porters coming through. Watch your steps.
dusk: Last crate for today. My back is ready for an ale at the inn.
Stacking the final pallets before the lanterns are lit.
night: Work is done for the night. Off to the tavern or to sleep.
Alleys get dangerous after dark. I am heading inside.
fight_started: Oi! Not near the cart! You'll spill the whole load!
Another brawl. I'm paid by the crate, not to watch this.
red_flag_raised: Ha, flagged. The watch will be on you now.
Red mark's up. Better you than me.
loot_dropped: Want a hand carrying that? For a coin or two.
Look at that chest. Some people have all the luck.
flee: I'm not paid enough for this. I'm off!

child_sindr._note: Children playing in Sindr alleys and square.
greeting_lit_ignis: Look, it is a real Shaper! Can you show us a spark?
Are you going to fight the ember hounds out past the east gate?
When I grow up, I want to make sparks just like you!
greeting_dim: My uncle is a Hush smith! He says his blades are sharper than any magic.
Can I see your belt pouches? Do you have shiny stones?
We were playing tag around the slag well!
greeting_outsider_lit: Whoa! Are you from far away? Your clothing looks totally different!
A traveler from another land! Have you seen the sea?
dusk: The lanterns are coming on! Mother will be furious if I am late for supper.
Sun is down behind the crag! Race you home!
night: We are not supposed to be out in the dark... Watch out for street robbers!
I saw glowing eyes near the keep wall earlier...
fight_started: A fight! A real fight! Look!
They're fighting! Somebody get the guards!
theft_seen: I saw that! You took it!
Thief! Thief! I'm telling the guards!
red_flag_raised: You got a red flag! Mother says that's bad.
loot_dropped: Treasure! Can I see what's inside?
Is that a real chest? Can I have one coin?

street_gang._note: Cutthroats of the Sindr Alley gang who call the hero out in the street. Swaggering, mocking, looking for a name.
challenge_issued: You. Yes, you. Think you're hard? Prove it, here in the street.
Nice boots. Shame about the rest of you. Fight me for them.
The Alley says you walk too proud. Put your hands up.
I've been watching you strut about. Let's see what you're worth.
challenge_accepted: Good. I was hoping you'd say yes.
Now we're talking. Don't cry when it's over.
challenge_refused: Walk away, then. Everyone saw you run.
Go on, scurry off. The Alley remembers faces.
gang_arrives: Lads! Over here, we've got a live one!
Didn't think I came alone, did you?

_delivery.challenge_issued: Swaggering and taunting, calling across the street.
_delivery.gang_arrives: Shouting to friends, loud and gleeful.
